intent: Show headcount hierarchically by department and sub-department

top_recommendation.description: Stacked bars showing part-of-whole within each group.
top_recommendation.clinical_use: AE severity breakdown per arm, disposition categories
top_recommendation.next_step: generate_canvasxpress_config with description='stacked bar of <metric> by <category>'

alternatives.description: Vertical or horizontal bars comparing values across categories.
alternatives.clinical_use: AE counts by SOC/arm, subject counts by group
alternatives.next_step: generate_canvasxpress_config with description='grouped bar chart of <metric> by <category>'

alternatives.description: Color-coded matrix — rows × columns with optional clustering and dendrograms.
alternatives.clinical_use: AE incidence by SOC × arm, gene expression heatmap
alternatives.next_step: generate_canvasxpress_config with description='heatmap of <numeric> with <factor1> rows and <factor2> columns'

alternatives.description: 100% stacked bars — each bar sums to 100%.
alternatives.clinical_use: Relative AE severity distribution across arms
alternatives.next_step: generate_canvasxpress_config with description='100% stacked bar of <metric> by <category>'

alternatives.description: Individual data points per group — best when n < ~50 per group.
alternatives.clinical_use: Individual lab values, small Phase I cohorts
alternatives.next_step: generate_canvasxpress_config with description='dot plot of <numeric> by <factor>'
alternatives.note: n_samples=8 is small — Dotplot shows every observation clearly.

generate_hint: Stacked chart of Headcount grouped by Department colored by SubDept — columns: Department, SubDept, Headcount

html.content:
Recommended

Stackedscore: 0.9

Stacked bars showing part-of-whole within each group.

Clinical use: AE severity breakdown per arm, disposition categories

  • 2+ categories ideal for stacking
  • few stack levels

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='stacked bar of <metric> by <category>'

Best for showing the `Headcount` for

Alternatives

Barscore: 1.0

Vertical or horizontal bars comparing values across categories.

Clinical use: AE counts by SOC/arm, subject counts by group

  • 1+ category + 1+ numeric
  • small-medium dataset
  • manageable category count

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='grouped bar chart of <metric> by <category>'

Heatmapscore: 1.0

Color-coded matrix — rows × columns with optional clustering and dendrograms.

Clinical use: AE incidence by SOC × arm, gene expression heatmap

  • 2 cats as row/col + numeric value

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='heatmap of <numeric> with <factor1> rows and <factor2> columns'

StackedPercentscore: 0.85

100% stacked bars — each bar sums to 100%.

Clinical use: Relative AE severity distribution across arms

  • 2+ cats → proportion comparison
  • few stack segments

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='100% stacked bar of <metric> by <category>'

Dotplotscore: 0.85

Individual data points per group — best when n < ~50 per group.

Clinical use: Individual lab values, small Phase I cohorts

  • cat + numeric
  • small n — show every point

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='dot plot of <numeric> by <factor>'
